recipes.name: The Good Place Special
ingredients: For the Peeps and M&M’s Chili (Champorado)
instructions: For the Peeps and M&M’s Chili (Champorado)

Into a large pot add rice along with water, evaporated milk, unsweetened cocoa powder, a pinch of salt, and granulated sugar. Over medium heat bring that whole mixture to a boil and then turn the heat to medium low and simmer for 15-25 minutes. Stir occasionally. - 1 ½ cups rice (sticky sushi or arborio) - 2 ½ cups water - 2 ½ cups evaporated milk - ⅓ cup unsweetened cocoa powder - Salt - ⅓ cup granulated sugar

When the rice is nearly done, add dark chocolate and stir to combine until the chocolate is melted, then add vanilla extract and espresso powder. Mix to combine. - 4 ounces dark chocolate - 1 tsp vanilla extract - 1 tsp espresso powder

Add to a bowl and top with some sweetened condensed milk. Optionally add some chopped peeps and M&M’s, but you might be better off leaving those out. Enjoy! - Sweetened condensed milk - Peeps chopped (optional) - M&M’s (optional)
For the White Chocolate Shrimp
Prepare your breading station by adding egg mixed with milk in one bowl, flour in your second bowl, and breadcrumbs in your third bowl. - 1 Egg - 1 cup milk - 1 cup flour - 1 cup breadcrumbs
Coat the shrimp first in your flour, followed by the egg and milk mixture, and then into your breadcrumbs. Make sure they are fully coated and then set onto a plate. - Shrimp peeled and deveined

Once all of your shrimp are coated, add vegetable oil to a pot and bring to 375°F. Add shrimp and cook each shrimp for 2-3 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from oil and set on a paper towel. - Vegetable oil
For the butter sauce
Add small minced shallot to a pan along with white wine, white wine vinegar, and heavy cream. - 1 small shallot minced - 2 tbsp white wine - 2 tbsp white wine vinegar - 1 ½ tbsp heavy cream

Cook over a medium heat until almost all the liquid has entirely reduced and then turn the heat down to a low heat. Add butter, a few chunks at a time. Once all the butter is added, remove from the heat but keep whisking to combine until a thick smooth sauce has been created. - 1 cup butter cut into chunks
For the white chocolate sauce

Follow all the steps above with changed quantities and adding white chocolate. Mix to combine. If the sauce starts to break, just add a few Tbsp of heavy cream. - 1 small shallot minced - 2 tbsp white wine - 2 tbsp white wine vinegar - 1 ½ tbsp heavy cream - 4 ounces butter cut into chunks - 4 ounces white chocolate
Serve with the fried shrimp and enjoy!
For the Jalapeno Poppers

Start by halving and hallowing your jalapenos. In a bowl combine cream cheese with shredded pepper jack. Mix to combine, and then scoop the mixture into each jalapeno half. - Jalapenos halved and hallowed - 8 ounces cream cheese - 8 ounces pepper jack cheese shredded
Prepare your breading station by adding egg mixed with milk in one bowl, flour in your second bowl, and breadcrumbs in your third bowl. - 1 Egg - 1 cup milk - 1 cup flour - 1 cup breadcrumbs
Add your jalapenos and to the flour mixture and then place them on a wire rack and let sit for 10 minutes.
Next, add them to the egg and milk mixture followed by the bread crumb mixture and then let sit on a wire rack for 45 minutes. Repeat this so they are coated twice before.
Preheat a pot with vegetable oil to 375°F and add jalapenos. Cook for 2-3 minutes before removing and placing on a wire rack to cool. - Vegetable oil
Serve and enjoy!
